stage.name: Domain of Valor
stage.description: East or south? A clear path forward doesn’t exist. The only certainty, however, is the challenges that await.
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

frozen_mountain_burdenbeast.name: Frozen Mountain Burdenbeast
frozen_mountain_burdenbeast.flavourText: Mountain burdenbeast buried by a sudden avalanche. Its thick layer of fat will help it survive the worst of it until rescue arrives.
abilities: Remains on standby in <Frigid> areas for a while without attacking.
Immediately revived if its plate is in Emergency Heater range

imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.name: Imperial Artillery Core Targeteer
imperial_artillery_core_targeteer.flavourText: A heavily-armored, sturdily-built core drone operated by artillery technicians of the Ursus army. They presage the withering firepower of the Ursus Artillery. The Ursus Artillery is a fire team that has bunkered down into the city. Though packing less firepower than naval guns, their equipment still shreds through buildings and armor with ease.
abilities: Flying unit.

pyric_originium_slug.name: Pyric Originium Slug
pyric_originium_slug.flavourText: A wild infected creature, the final stages of infection having led them to burn even hotter. Their fluids, hot as magma, melt even their own bodies. Once cooled, beautiful patterns can be found in the pools they leave behind.
abilities: Attacks deal Burn

elite_wasteland_plunderer.name: Elite Wasteland Plunderer
elite_wasteland_plunderer.flavourText: An elite member of a bandit gang operating in the wastelands, equipped with the best gear the bandits can get their hands on. The most vicious plunderers are completely indifferent to the suffering of others, having long forgotten that they were once just the most desperate of civilians.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
After several attacks, steals 3 DP and recovers a certain amount of HP

luminous_fowlbeast.name: Luminous Fowlbeast
luminous_fowlbeast.flavourText: A small creature that can only be seen far from nomadic cities. With a flutter of its wings, it escapes once more into the shadows.
abilities: Upon taking damage, becomes Invulnerable and cannot move for a period of time

yeti_caster_leader.name: Yeti Caster Leader
yeti_caster_leader.flavourText: An elite caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra, boasting greater combat capabilities. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

rogue_burdenbeast.name: Rogue Burdenbeast
rogue_burdenbeast.flavourText: Burdenbeasts that once served the lord ameers have escaped into the wilderness, still carrying their loads. Their time in captivity has made them more agile than normal burdenbeasts, and better at fighting those who would take them captive again.
abilities: Starts immune to Physical and Arts damage below a certain amount.
When taking more than a certain amount of damage in a single instance, falls down and randomly drops a large amount of Minor Ingredients (triggers only once), losing its damage reduction effect.
Periodically drops <Crude Gold> when held in <Large Corral>.

liquid_shifter.name: 'Liquid Shifter'
liquid_shifter.flavourText: Curious little creatures that roam the wilderness, able to emulate images in mirages. The latest research indicates that this is not a true transformation, but merely an optical illusion.
abilities: Appears disguised as another enemy. Does not attack when disguised.
Reveals true form upon taking damage.
Chance to drop <Standard-Issue Item> when defeated.
Periodically creates <Fresh Water> when held in <Large Corral>.

sandfall_crystalhoof.name: Sandfall Crystalhoof
sandfall_crystalhoof.flavourText: An extremely rare and exquisite beast. It feeds on rhizomes, giving its coat a dense but fine light golden luster. When on the move, it's almost as if golden sand was falling from its body, so it is highly sought by collectors and artists. However, it is extremely nimble and difficult to capture, but is the secret ingredient spoken of in legends... do you really want to hunt it?
abilities: After being attacked, runs away a random distance and rests for a period of time
Moves through different areas

consortium_of_pincers.name: 'Consortium of Pincers'
consortium_of_pincers.flavourText: A Cragpincer with a gigantic crystallized shell, its back broad enough to carry two average-sized cragpincers. If it can withstand the weight of two cragpincers and the crystals on its back, who knows how strong it actually is, so do be careful of its pincers!
abilities: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked

sand_voyager.name: 'Sand Voyager'
sand_voyager.flavourText: A 2nd generation transport vehicle engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Can carry up to four soldiers over desert terrain or coordinate in urban defense.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 4 max), and will be unloaded when this unit reaches a Ladder

shadowing_trilby_asher.name: 'Shadowing Trilby Asher'
shadowing_trilby_asher.flavourText: To the Duke of Caster, a 'Trilby Asher' is more of a consumable than a collectible. On the day a 'Trilby Asher' is honored with the job, another 'Shadowing Trilby Asher' is also born—only succeeding their predecessor when their mentor dies.
abilities: After several attacks, moves towards the next checkpoint for the next attack

deathveil_assassin.name: Deathveil Assassin
deathveil_assassin.flavourText: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.
abilities: Invisible; the next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage.
Has Arts and Physical dodge.
Temporarily loses Invisibility, Physical dodge, and Arts dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.
Can pass through a blocking unit once when HP drops to below 50%.

dublinn_elite_spec_ops.name: Dublinn Elite Spec Ops
dublinn_elite_spec_ops.flavourText: An elite soldier under the command of 'The Brigadier.' The core of their ambush and assault tactics, they are well-disciplined and completely devoted to the cause.
abilities: Ignites Reeds upon passing by them
After several attacks, unleashes 5 consecutive slashes at the target

dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Guard
dublinn_flamechaser_elite_guard.flavourText: An elite Dublinn defender fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, the Arts embedded in their equipment make them hard to defeat.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Burn and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an Invisible <Ember of Avarice> that must be damaged 10 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

heavy_swamp_rover.name: Heavy Swamp Rover
heavy_swamp_rover.flavourText: A military vehicle capable of traveling smoothly through swampy terrain, fitted with advanced detection equipment and reinforced armor.
abilities: Immune to the effects of Mire
Reveals Camouflaged and Invisible allied units within range

mateos_guard.name: Mateo's Guard
mateos_guard.flavourText: Mateo's guard. Certain Coalition Army leaders have cultivated such individuals, leading them to feel that they are above their peers.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced

nightzmora_follower.name: Nightzmora Follower
nightzmora_follower.flavourText: Pretenders who began following Nightmare Knight after his battles and 'Performance Art'. Many attempt to guess at the true identity of the Nightzmora from ancient texts and history books, even though he himself considers it blasphemy against the ancient rituals.
abilities: [Coalescing Fear] Deals Physical damage to all operators with no visibility directly behind them

sarkaz_boneguard_torturer.name: Sarkaz Boneguard Torturer
sarkaz_boneguard_torturer.flavourText: An elite armsmaster responsible for protecting the Feranmut's skeleton, carefully selected by the most senior members of the Military Commission. The degree of their fusion with the Feranmut's nerves defies common understanding, with their ancient witchcraft drilled deep into their bodies.
abilities: Recovers a portion of HP and gains increased ATK when either enemy or friendly units are defeated within range (can stack).
Leaves behind 2 <Blood Amber> when defeated.

sarkaz_royal_court_elite_caster.name: Sarkaz Royal Court Elite Caster
sarkaz_royal_court_elite_caster.flavourText: An elite caster of the Sarkaz Royal Court. Sarkaz witchcraft is often more dangerous in battle than war machines. Their skill and discipline are second to none.
abilities: Attacks deal additional Necrosis
Locks on to your units, dealing continuous Arts damage, and causing area Necrosis when casting is complete

scorching_steam_tank.name: Scorching Steam Tank
scorching_steam_tank.flavourText: Advanced armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage. Virtually unstoppable when it is on a rampage.
abilities: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

spined_shellbeast.name: Spined Shellbeast
spined_shellbeast.flavourText: A type of hard and prickly shellbeast. If it retracts its head into its shell, just save your energy.
abilities: Retreats into its shell upon taking damage, reducing any further physical and Arts damage to 0. In this state, upon receiving damage from allied Operators, deals physical damage equal to 100% of their own ATK to the attacker. Will come out from its shell after taking no damage for a period of time

tsch_gg_tt_leader.name: Tschäggättä Leader
tsch_gg_tt_leader.flavourText: A special ops squad secretly formed in Victoria by SilverAsh, based on the Kjerag folk legend 'Tschäggättä' used to hush crying children. They are able to resist brutally cold temperatures, and are extremely proficient in mountainous combat. As squad leaders, they are truly the elite among the elite.
abilities: Gains status resistance
Gains increased ATK during <Snowfall>
Attacks lower the target's DEF

pompeii.name: 'Pompeii'
pompeii.flavourText: A massive infected beast. These aberrations were born in a special high-temperature environment. Nobody wants to approach these creatures due to their grotesque appearance and the extreme heat they give off. The existence of these giant creatures has been known since ancient times, but to see one warped by infection is terrifyingly unforgettable...
abilities: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half

frozen_monstrosity.name: 'Frozen Monstrosity'
frozen_monstrosity.flavourText: A Sami snowpriest went to the endless tundra to defend against the demons that invaded her homeland. In the end, she went insane and became a part of the tundra's curse.
abilities: Normal attacks and Ice Nova deal Arts damage and applies Cold to targets
If a target is defeated or retreats while Frozen, its Redeployment Time is doubled
Can activate Originium Ice Crystals around the battlefield
